name: Accountability
description: Psychology-inspired agent accountability framework with task board, scorecards, and evaluation.

dataDir.description: Directory for accountability data (tasks, scorecards). Defaults to ~/.openclaw/accountability/

evaluationModel.description: Model to use for judge evaluations (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514)

evaluationProvider.description: Provider to use for judge evaluations (e.g. anthropic)

scorecardDecayDays.description: Number of days before older scorecard entries start decaying

selfCritiqueEnabled.description: Whether agents must self-critique before marking tasks complete
